revisionDesc.change: Submit - Entered publishes collections to lines 4–5 and 18; replaced *rho-cross* with *stauros* throughout, in line with the edition (image checked); added |reg| for οἰκε[ίας] (4) ἐνοικείου (9), ἐνοίκειον (11; accent also corrected), οἰκείας (15).
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Make appropriate idno changes.
This has to be renamed to p.kramer;;15
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - accept text and comments by JC

Vote - AcceptText - Lin2 δευτέρα → <#δευτέρα=2#> lin3 τρίτης → <#τρίτης=3#> lin11 <#δ'=4#> → <#δ=4#> or <#δ'=4#> dependent upon whether the raised horizontal stroke after δ is understood to be the same as a tick in earlier periods, I am inclined to leave out the tick, another opinion please) lin18 *x* → *rhocross* lin17, 19, 21, 23, 24, 25, 26 not sure whether the *x* are the correct mark up, should these signs, which undoubtedly look like an „x“, not be understood as a cross (another opinion please) lin20 Ποιβάμμων → <:Φοιβάμμωνος|reg|Φοιβάμμων:> lin21 Παλους I do not think that the alternatives should find their way into the text I would print just Π̣α̣λους (the alternative readings introduce names otherwise unattested, which I think is counterproductive – such information belongs in the commentary, as indeed is to be found in the edition) lin23 and 25 μισθώσι → <:μισθώσει|reg|μισθώσι:>
